problem.observed: The exact open BRENTOIL lifecycle was attached to the V58 hypothesis ledger while next_action and minimum_additional_evidence remained null.
problem.impact: The continuous report preserved current state but did not state the evidence required to update the inconclusive exit hypothesis.

repair.behavior: Every exact open lifecycle receives a generic authoritative-close action and explicit diagnostic/live-change evidence requirements when no stronger route-specific requirement already exists.
repair.route_specific_precedence: Existing route-specific next_action and minimum_additional_evidence values are preserved.

minimum_additional_evidence.diagnostic_update: one technically complete authoritative close with exact exit fill, fees, funding, completed-path MFE/MAE/giveback, and frozen profit-lock comparisons
minimum_additional_evidence.live_change: a preregistered source-compatible sample covering both configured sides with positive after-cost and largest-winner-removed results

validation.red_test: The focused open-lifecycle projection test failed with KeyError: next_action before implementation.
validation.supervisor_reload: The in-flight generator-drift cycle aborted, the wrapper restarted, and the rolling report published the repaired fields.

assessment.recommendation: Continue the frozen lifecycle until authoritative close, then compare actual after-cost economics with the preregistered alternatives.
failure_modes: A single open lifecycle can overstate or understate exit-policy value.
The challenger estimates exclude funding and additional exit slippage until the actual close is reconciled.
Route-lifecycle and venue research sources can transiently fail freshness checks; the supervisor retains the last valid report and retries fail-closed.
falsifiers: A future rolling report drops the non-null action or evidence requirement for this open lifecycle.
A route-specific evidence requirement is overwritten by the generic fallback.
The authoritative close does not retain exact fills, fees, funding, excursion, and frozen profit-lock comparisons.
A preregistered compatible multi-lifecycle sample contradicts the current no-change disposition.
